scripts.dev:web: npm run stop:web && npm --prefix apps/evolyn-web run dev
scripts.dev:core: npm run stop:core && cd apps/evolyn-core && make run
scripts.dev:core-windows: npm run stop:core && cd apps/evolyn-core && make run-windows
scripts.dev:core-mac: npm run stop:core && cd apps/evolyn-core && make run-mac
scripts.stop:services: npm run stop:web && npm run stop:core
